title: Hocus Pocus
tagline: Witches back in Salem. Lollies at the door.
about: Three witch sisters are brought back to life in Salem on Halloween night.
cue: Serve the mains when the witches take over the town Halloween party.

    StartersWitch finger pretzelsPretzel rods dipped in green white chocolate with almond nailsHow to make it200g white chocolate2 drops of green food colouring20 pretzel rods20g flaked almondsMelt the white chocolate and tint it green.Dip the pretzel rods most of the way.Press a flaked almond on the tip of each as a nail.Lay on baking paper to set.Binx black sesame cat crackersThackery Binx, cursed to live as a black catHow to make itAs written, serves 4Crisp black sesame and parmesan crackers cut into cat shapes, with a whipped feta and honey dip for little paws.Rub 80g cold butter into 150g plain flour, 50g grated parmesan, 40g black sesame seeds and half a tsp salt.Add 2 to 3 tbsp cold water to form a dough.Chill 20 minutes, roll 3mm thick and cut out cat shapes.Bake at 180°C for 10 to 12 minutes until crisp.Blitz 150g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt and 1 tbsp honey until smooth.MainsCauldron pumpkin stewLamb shoulder braised with cumin, cinnamon and pumpkin, over couscousHow to make it1.2kg lamb shoulder, diced2 brown onions, chopped2 tsp ground cumin1 tsp ground cinnamon500ml chicken stock400g crushed tomatoes600g pumpkin, cubed300g couscous2 tbsp vegetable oilBrown the lamb in oil.Soften the onions with the cumin and cinnamon.Add the stock and tomatoes and braise at 160°C.Add the pumpkin for the last hour.Prepare the couscous as the packet says.Serve the stew over the couscous.Billy Butcherson's clam chowderA cold New England Halloween nightHow to make itAs written, serves 4Creamy New England chowder of clams, smoky bacon and potato, served in crusty bread bowls with chives and a scatter of oyster crackers.Steam 1kg clams in 125ml white wine, covered, until open, then pick the meat and strain the liquor.Render 150g diced bacon, add 1 onion and 2 celery sticks and cook 6 minutes.Stir in 2 tbsp flour, then the clam liquor, 500ml milk and 400g diced potato and simmer 15 minutes.Add 200ml cream and the clams and heat through.Hollow 4 round crusty rolls and ladle in.Finish with chives and crackers.SweetsCandy applesApples dipped in a shiny red hard candy coatingHow to make it4 apples400g caster sugar125ml water2 tbsp golden syrup3 drops of red food colouringPush sticks into the apples.Boil the sugar, water and golden syrup to 150°C.Add the red colouring.Dip and twirl each apple.Set on oiled baking paper until hard.Apple cider doughnutsCider doughnut rings in cinnamon sugar. I smell children.How to make it500ml apple juice350g plain flour2 tsp baking powder3 tsp ground cinnamon200g caster sugar80ml buttermilk1 egg30g butter, melted2 L vegetable oilSimmer the apple juice down until reduced and cool.Mix the flour, baking powder, cinnamon and half the sugar, then the reduced cider, buttermilk, egg and butter.Roll 1.5cm thick and cut 12 rings.Fry in the vegetable oil at 175°C, 1 minute a side.Toss in the remaining sugar mixed with cinnamon.DrinksBubbling lime sorbet punchLime sorbet, lemonade and pineapple juice punch with gummy worms, no alcoholHow to make it500ml lime sorbet1 L lemonade, cold250ml pineapple juice12 gummy wormsScoop the sorbet into a punch bowl.Pour over the lemonade and pineapple juice so it froths up.Hang gummy worms over the side of the bowl.Mulled cranberry and orange juiceSimmered in the cauldron.
